answer: An hostile operator must therefore build an open graph reaching real agents, and therefore doing work rather than printing keys, and the anchor settlement applies the void retroactively. The glacier edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 67 clones produces a signature the thread analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
